R2: Case: On-Time Delivery Crisis - Rate dropped from 92% to 78% due to 3 underperforming logistics partners. Action plan?
Case: Last-Mile Cost Reduction - Reduce from ₹55 to ₹40 per shipment in 6 months without hurting speed.
Case: Geographic Expansion - Launch in 20 tier-2/3 cities with limited logistics infrastructure.
Case: Same-Day Delivery Launch - Operational changes, cut-off times, pricing, and business case for 5 metro cities.
Case: Monsoon Disruption - Heavy monsoons causing massive delays. 50,000 orders stuck in transit. Crisis management?
Case: Delivery Partner Bankruptcy - Partner handling 30% of volume shuts down overnight. Reroute 20,000 daily shipments.
Case: COD to Prepaid Conversion - Shift from 70% COD to 50% prepaid in 6 months.
Case: Delivery Time Slot Failure - 40% of slot-based deliveries missed. Fix slot adherence or revert to day-based?
Case: Rural Delivery Economics - Delivery costs 3x higher (₹150 vs ₹50) in rural areas. How to make viable?
Case: Stolen Package Epidemic - 5% theft rate in specific geography. Some claims may be fraudulent. How to solve?
Case: Festival Sale Preparedness - 6x volume spike in 8 weeks. Last year had massive delays. How to prepare?
Case: Undeliverable Addresses - 8% of orders have incomplete/incorrect addresses. How to reduce failures?
Case: Gig Economy Labor - 5,000 gig workers demanding better pay and insurance. Some threatening strike.
Case: Packaging Damage - 6% of deliveries arrive with damaged packaging. How to reduce?
Case: Electric Vehicle Transition - Transition 50% of fleet to EVs. Challenges and phasing?
